info.title: MKTAgent API
info.description: Multi-tenant marketing automation API. All endpoints are tenant-scoped via the Bearer JWT (Google login). Responses use the { data, meta? } | { error, details? } envelope.

200.description: The logged-in user identity + config defaults

post.summary: Create a post (brief) under one of the user's campaigns

get.summary: Get one post with its embedded campaign

patch.summary: Edit a post's config (asset/targets/schedule). Editable states only.

409.description: Post is in a non-editable (scheduler-owned) state
Post is being published; cannot delete

post.summary: Approve a post in review → ready (schedules it)

409.description: Post is not in review state

post.summary: Reject a post in review → rework (with feedback)

409.description: Post is not in review state

post.summary: Revoke the current browser session (clears the cookie)
Run copy-gen for this post now (brief|rework → review)
post.description: On-demand copy generation instead of waiting for the cron. Shares the copy-gen advisory lock.

409.description: Copy-gen busy, or post not in brief/rework

post.summary: Publish this post now (ready → posting → fan-out). REAL social post.
post.description: User-triggered immediate publish after review; coexists with the scheduler cron (first to claim wins).

delete.summary: Delete a campaign (cascades to its posts)

get.summary: Begin per-user OAuth for a social platform (302 to consent)

302.description: Redirect to the platform consent screen

get.summary: List the caller's social connections + status (read-only)
get.description: Metadata-only view over the OAuthToken store. Never returns token values and never touches the publish path. Unconnected platforms appear as not_connected with a connectUrl.

schema.description: Open-shaped funnel payload (fields vary by source); email is required after normalization.
Open-shaped funnel payload (fields vary by source); email is required after normalization.
Open-shaped funnel payload (fields vary by source); email is required after normalization.

get.summary: List the current user's captured leads

post.summary: Start a goal-based run: analyze a message → clarify or plan a DAG
post.description: Master Agent extracts intent, asks clarification if required slots are missing, else plans a dynamic agent DAG. Returns the run (status awaiting_clarification | planned | failed).

get.summary: List the current user's workflow runs

post.summary: Answer clarification questions → re-plan the run
Save a planned run as a named Saved Flow (no execution)
post.description: Names a planned run so it appears in Saved Flows. Does NOT execute — execution happens later via /execute from Active Flows.

409.description: Run is not in planned state

patch.description: Updates the flow name regardless of run status. Unlike /save (planned-only), this relabels an already-executed flow.

get.summary: Get a run with its nodes + artifacts

delete.summary: Delete a run / Saved Flow (cascades to nodes + artifacts)
delete.description: Removes the run and all its nodes + artifacts. A run mid-execution (running) is refused with 409.

post.summary: Execute a planned/failed run (async) → returns immediately as running
post.description: Flips the run to running and executes the DAG DETACHED (the request returns at once — no long hang). SSE (/events) drives live node status; the executor halts BEFORE the external-write node (publisher) → needs_approval. Re-runnable from a failed state.

200.description: Run now running (live status via SSE)

409.description: Run already in flight or not executable

post.summary: Approve a gated node (e.g. publisher) → resume execution (async)
post.description: Releases the approval gate for one external-write node and resumes the run DETACHED (returns at once; SSE drives status). Publishing runs the real publish path.

200.description: Run now running (live status via SSE)

get.summary: List named Saved Flows (for the sidebar + Active Flows)
Get the latest run for a chat session (history restore)
get.description: Conversational unify: reopen the run a chat spawned. 404 when the chat has no run (legacy intake-only chat).

404.description: No run for this chat / cross-tenant

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of this user's status changes
get.description: text/event-stream. Auth via Bearer header OR ?token= query (EventSource). Emits `ready` then `post.status` {postId,status,campaignId,postUrls,error,at} and `node.status` {runId,nodeId,agentId,status,error,at} events.
